scientific_goal: Determine whether a TCN63 neural SDE can learn the broadband remainder after a contiguous ten-peak oscillator bank removes 84-1041 Hz, and whether applying the same fixed remainder operator to generated neural paths improves the final hybrid without instability.
constraints: Fit and select with training repetitions 1-12 and validation repetitions 13-14 only; test repetitions 15-16 stay locked.
Keep rank10 plus the stored HP50 spatial mean, native sampling, TCN63, damped-residual drift and constant diagonal diffusion fixed.
Use the exact ten contiguous midpoint bands and frozen oscillator artifacts from the completed oracle study.
Every evaluation compares raw and output-filtered versions of the identical neural rollout and oscillator draws.
Output filtering is offline zero-phase processing for stationary generation, not a causal forecasting procedure.
Do not judge success from NLL or finite survival alone; compare broadband PSD above 1.5 kHz, covariance, energy, ACF and contamination of the oscillator region.

arms.description: Five-epoch one-step NLL parent from random initialization.
Five more NLL epochs at lower learning rate to test convergence before rollout objectives.
Short joint displacement-velocity energy-score and moment calibration from the converged NLL parent.
